name: tia_import_block
description: Import or update a PLC block from SimaticML XML.

folder.description: Target group folder path for the block (optional).

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing block if it exists (default true).

plc_name.description: Name of the target PLC (optional, defaults to first PLC).

xml_content.description: The SimaticML XML string containing the block definition.
